Hi, we need a properly formatted terminal session report for the DevOps handover package. I have a raw notes file at `devops/reports/2025/session_notes_2025-06-15.txt` in the workspace that an engineer left behind — it documents a system health check they ran on June 15th, 2025. The notes are messy and unstructured.

Please convert these notes into a clean, professional report file called `handover_diagnostic_report.md`. The report must document all 5 operations the engineer performed, following our team's standard terminal session display conventions (you should follow the display convention documented in your SKILL.md). Pay special attention to the failed API call (it had an error and a non-zero exit code) and the long log inspection output (it had over 100 lines). The final document should look like someone is watching a live terminal session — including the original commands, their outputs, any error details, and interpretations of what the results mean.
